cells.desc: an open ring drawing streams of light inward from every side of the panel into one blinding point at its centre, the streams stretched into long curved trails
a lance as thick as a stone column driving across the panel from border to border, a hard white core with light spiralling around it and a trail of flame filling the frame behind it

a blue lance meeting a scarlet crescent head on at the centre of the panel: a blown out pure white sphere at the point of contact, a saturated blue body on one side and a saturated scarlet body on the other, a flat expanding shockwave ring across the whole panel, and shards and sparks flying outward along radial speed lines
